license: US public records; no reuse restriction; 10 req/s + declared User-Agent

field_map.periodOfReport: quarter end, ISO (normalized from EDGAR MM-DD-YYYY)
field_map.valueTotal: as-filed total value, full USD (post-2023 rule; NOT thousands)
field_map.otherManagersCount: other included managers on this report
field_map.holdings[]: issuer, titleOfClass, cusip (entity key), value USD, shares, sharesType SH|PRN, putCall, discretion

confidence_model: as-filed regulatory records (high; holdings are 45 days STALE at publication by rule — any signal is crowd formation, not news)
cadence: 15-min poll of the getcurrent feed; day-file dedup by accession
_cap: FOCUSED-MANAGER CAP (explicit, never silent): filings with more than 250 positions are archived summary-only (holdings table omitted). This encodes the cluster hypothesis — capacity-constrained managers in small caps (EDGE DOCTRINE #2); mega-manager index-hugging tables would dominate archive bytes and add no cluster signal. Cap constant: FOCUSED_MAX_HOLDINGS in server/edgar13f.ts.
_note: Universal archive envelope (approved 2026-07-04): dataset-level manifest; datum-level fields where information varies per record. Append-only JSONL unless stated; readers pick field_map from here.
